subject: Proposal: Priority onramp + tail-latency commitment for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@acmeanalytics.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai; jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Need priority SLA & burst for Q1 launch

Markus / Jonas,

Quick note from the platform team here at Acme — we’re accelerating a product launch into Q1 and expect a 3x spike in inference volume for the first 8 weeks. Given that, procurement asked us to explore a renewal addendum that includes:

- A premium support tier during the launch window (dedicated response channel, 1-hour P1 response)
- Tail latency SLO guarantees at 95th/99th for our primary model (we’re seeing occasional p95 spikes today)
- A defined short-term burst capacity (reserve GPUs or priority queueing)

Can you share a rough sketch of what Redwood would propose and any delta to our renewal pricing? We’re targeting a signed amendment by Dec 10 to lock provisioning.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

—Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform, Acme Analytics
eln: +1 415 555 0191

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-10T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Need priority SLA & burst for Q1 launch

Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. High level we can do a bundled addendum for the renewal that covers all three asks. Quick outline below, happy to convert to formal terms once we align.

Proposed sketch (pilot window = first 8 weeks post-launch):
- Premium Support: Priority channel to a named CS engineer + 1-hour P1 response SLA during the pilot window (Mon–Sun, 06:00–22:00 PT). 24/7 optional at additional cost.
- Tail Latency SLOs (primary model): p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms (measured at edge-e2e request path). We’ll include an outyear credits scheme: if p99 breaches more than X% of measurements in a billing month, apply service credit.
- Burst Capacity: Reservation of 2x baseline GPUs for up to 6 hours/day per region during the pilot; automated priority routing and pre-warm.

Estimated commercial delta: two options — (A) one-time launch uplift + monthly premium during pilot, or (B) longer-term tier upgrade with a blended commit. I’ll have numbers from Jonas by EOD tomorrow.

Operational asks from our side if you go ahead:
- A short traffic profile (95/99 percentiles, peak qps, model size, typical context length)
- Contact for network/KMS questions for private data paths
- PO or procurement contact to accelerate addendum signature

If you’re free, let’s do a 30-minute call tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT to align and I’ll bring Marissa (CS) to cover onboarding.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@acmeanalytics.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2027-11-11T08:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Need priority SLA & burst for Q1 launch

Thanks Markus — that reads well. Quick clarifications from procurement:

- Can the p95/p99 definitions call out measurement window and sample size? They want to avoid noisy microbursts inflating p99.
- For burst capacity: can we get a firm commitment on a lead time to scale beyond 6 hours if needed? (e.g., 24-hour advance to increase for special events)
- Pricing model preference: they prefer one-time uplifts where possible to avoid long-term commit.

Attached a traffic snapshot and our PO contact (procurement@acmeanalytics.com). Would appreciate a written draft with the measurement definitions included — we’ll circulate to legal. Call tomorrow at 10 works for me.

—Elena

Attachments: launch_traffic_snapshot.csv (see attached)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-12T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Need priority SLA & burst for Q1 launch

Elena — following the call, attaching a proposed amendment and the ops-onramp checklist. Key changes based on procurement questions:

- Measurement window: we’ll measure tail latencies over 5-minute sliding windows aggregated per region; p95/p99 computed over the windowed distribution with a minimum sample threshold (>= 1,000 requests per window). We’ll add language to exclude maintenance windows and documented upstream outages.
- Burst scaling: lead time for capacity increase is 24 hours for planned increases; emergency escalation route available for sub-24-hour increases (subject to availability) — we’ll bake in a prioritized provisioning clause.
- Pricing: provided two line items — one-time launch uplift (covers pre-warm and reserved burst) + short pilot premium (8-week). Option B shows an annualized tier upgrade if you prefer to keep it on the contract.

Attached: redwood_priority_sla_v2.pdf (draft amendment), ops-onramp-checklist.xlsx

Next steps: if procurement is ok with the measurement language, Marissa will propose an onboarding timeline and named contacts for monitoring. Once you confirm option A vs B, Jonas will prepare the commercial sheet for PO.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: 2027-11-15T16:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Need priority SLA & burst for Q1 launch — final alignment

Elena / Procurement — small operational points before we hand to legal and procurement for signature: 

- Monitoring & Alerts: we’ll provide a shared Datadog dashboard and a webhook for your incident tool; we’ll retain 90 days of per-request traces for diagnostics during the pilot.
- Testing window: pre-launch load test (3-hour ramp) during the final staging week; Redwood will own pre-warm and KV cache priming.
- Contact roster: I’m assigning Sarah Park (CS Engineer) and Ravi Nair (SRE lead) as your named contacts for the pilot. Full contact info in the ops checklist.

Procurement — please confirm preferred commercial option A (one-time uplift + 8-week pilot fee) vs B (annual tier change). If A, we’ll issue an amendment and a DocuSign link; if B, we’ll convert to a standard term amendment. Targeting signature by Dec 10 to guarantee capacity allocation.

Thanks, looking forward to supporting the launch.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
